newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy union leader threatens wider November strike.
newsitem.headline: Italy union leader threatens wider November strike.

text.p: The leader of one of Italy's three main national unions threatened on Tuesday to widen a one-day national strike on November 15 of 1.5 million engineering and metalworkers to include building workers.

The leader of the CGIL union Sergio Cofferati threatened to widen the November 15 industrial action which has already been agreed to press their pay claim in a dispute over how to interpret a 1993 labour pact.

"If Federmeccanica does to change its position we will decide in the next few days on the inclusion of other categories of industry, including building workers," said Cofferati after a committee meeting of the building workers sector of CGIL.

Italy's three main national unions CGIL, CISL and UIL will meet on October 17 to discuss ways to support the metalworkers in their dispute with the Italy's metal industry employers federation grouping Federmeccanica.
